svg.text: Wireframe notes: data loads once per session (no per-row requests). Only names, paths, sizes and statuses are shown — never section or file text (FR-10).
Paths are repo-relative, ~/.claude/… or <plugin>@<version>/… — never absolute (FR-4). Git status chips: tracked / untracked / ignored / outside repo / unknown.
Partition kind / source lists and the "first user prompt" handling are open questions in requirements.md; values here are illustrative (PoC sample session).
